data.explanation: This is a second payment reminder from a furniture store for furniture you already received. You need to pay the total of €695.00 to the IBAN shown by 11 December 2026. If you don't pay in time, the store says it will hand the debt over to a collection agency (Inkasso), and you would then also have to pay their extra fees. If you already paid, keep your proof of payment ready. If you believe the amount is wrong, contact the store directly before the deadline; this is not a court order, so no legal appeal process applies here.
